dash.name: Dash
dash.description: Increases your pet's movement speed by 80% for 10 sec.

growl.name: Growl
growl.description: Your pet growls at the target, generating threat, taunting the target to attack the pet.

furious-bite.name: Furious Bite
furious-bite.description: The Wolf bites the target's feet, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

tendon-rip.name: Tendon Rip
tendon-rip.description: The Aqiri slashes at the target's feet, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

dune-strider.name: Dune Strider
dune-strider.description: Increases the Aqiri's movement speed by 30%.
